title: ChatbotIntent
description: Schema for a single intent in the Olá Market chatbot registry.

intent_id.description: Unique snake_case identifier. Used as the canonical key throughout the codebase.

display_name.description: Short human-readable label shown on chatbot quick-action buttons.

category.description: Grouping used for UI organisation and routing.

example_utterances.description: Representative user messages used for intent classification training / few-shot prompting.

required_slots.description: Ordered list of information pieces the bot must collect before resolving.

resolution_type.description: How the intent is fulfilled once all slots are collected.

resolution_config.description: Type-specific config. Shape validated by validate.py based on resolution_type.

escalation_triggers.description: Conditions (returned by the API or detected during flow) that force human handoff.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum classifier confidence to activate this intent. Below this → ask for clarification.

is_button_visible.description: Whether this intent appears as a quick-action button when the chatbot opens.

name.description: Snake_case slot identifier used in response_template placeholders.

prompt.description: Question the bot asks the user to fill this slot.

validation_regex.description: Optional Python-compatible regex the user's answer must match.

optional.description: If true, the bot skips this slot when the user says they don't have it.
